purpose: Regression verification standard — what to test after each cleanup wave to confirm no breakage
principle: A wave is not complete until functional tests pass, not merely when admin commands succeed
mail: External email delivers to all public-facing addresses
Outbound automation email sends from no-reply@/notifications@
Delegate access for shared mailboxes unchanged
collaboration: Teams channel access for all active Teams
automation: Power Automate flows trigger on schedule
Customer Voice form submissions route correctly
web: App Service (HOST-02) HTTP 200 on health endpoint
GitHub Actions workflows succeed on next trigger
financial_data_safety: Pre-need Outlook calendar sync confirms appointments present
No appointments duplicated or dropped after mailbox changes
